reference: reference.jpg (two phone screens: Today on the left, Profile on the right)
unit: percent of the frame's width, measured from the frame's top-left corner; viewport 1440 wide, overview page, default variant
adaptation: The reference has no desktop screen. This file is the desktop design: one wide dashboard that lays the two phone screens' cards out side by side. Do not draw phones or device frames on desktop. At 375px the Today page reads as the reference's left screen and the Profile page as its right screen.

frame.backdrop: grey-green dusk gradient with the reference's dune lines and four-point stars; no photo

rail.note: the reference's tab bar turned vertical: Today, Progress, Sessions, Profile, icon over label, the active one with a soft glowing ring

title.note: WED RAMADAN 9 in the thin display serif with flourishes, moon and star mark at its right

dates.note: date beads joined by one poured strip; the active bead is dark with a warm glow

arc.note: Imsak and Iftar card: sun arc with a glowing sun over a frosted upper half, darker lower half with both times, bell line in a cut-out tab at the bottom right

water.note: teal liquid card with the WATER label in a poured tab at the top left, droplet in a round well, segmented bar

gather.note: amber pill event card, avatar at the right, glow underneath

dune.note: dark dune panel: Good evening in the display serif, large four-point star, layered dune lines, settings icon top right

person.note: profile card with the avatar tile overlapping its top-left corner, sessions and journeys counts, Share in a poured tab at the bottom left

progress.note: amber daily progress card with its title in a poured tab at the top right, tree icon, seven thin vertical bars with day labels

upgrade.note: dark frosted upgrade strip with a flame mark

requirements.text: Desktop is a real dashboard in the reference's liquid language, not phone mockups placed on a page
Liquid glass on every card at 1440 and at 375: translucent fill, blur, light edge, coloured glow under the teal and amber cards
Poured tabs as in the reference: WATER label, Share, Daily progress title, bell line
Navigation is the reference's: Today, Progress, Sessions, Profile; each opens a working page
At 375 the Today page matches the reference's left screen and the Profile page its right screen, with a bottom tab bar fully visible
Every date bead, water step, day bar and button changes something when clicked
